member_names: State Key Laboratory of Tree Genetics and Breeding
title: PagERF021 Protein and Its Regulation of Stress Response Genes
summary: This cluster revolves around the PagERF021 protein, which is located in the nucleus and regulates various genes and pathways in response to stress. The protein is overexpressed in PagERF021 transgenic poplar, which exhibits resilience. PagERF021 regulates several genes, including AGL16, DAB, KUP, MDA, NAC17, NBT, and POD, which are involved in stress response and other processes. Additionally, the cluster includes various organisms, such as Arabidopsis, Populus alba, and P. trichocarpa, which are related to the study of PagERF021 and its functions.
